D: Elphaba and Glinda face the fallout of their choices as the Emerald City turns against the Wicked Witch.
P: Serve the banquet when the Emerald City celebrates Glinda's engagement.
S: the Emerald City, green from top to bottom
Pistachios blitzed with butter, sugar and flour into crumbly shortbread rounds, tinted green and dusted with sugar.

Light choux puffs baked hollow and crisp, filled with pink strawberry whipped cream and dusted with icing sugar and edible glitter like floating bubbles. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the pan and cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time. Pipe 24 rounds onto lined trays and bake 25 minutes, then pierce each and dry in the turned-off oven for 10 minutes. Blitz 150g strawberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar, fold into 300ml whipped cream and pipe into the cooled puffs. Dust with icing sugar.
Small shortcrust cases filled with a gruyère, chive and cream custard, baked until puffed and golden on top.
M: Whole chicken roasted with butter, lemon and tarragon under the skin, with green beans, peas and creamy potatoes.
Kiamo Ko spiced lamb with green couscous
Kiamo Ko, Elphaba's castle out in Winkie Country

Lamb shoulder rubbed with smoked paprika and cumin, slow roasted until it pulls apart, over a bright green herb couscous with pomegranate and minted yoghurt. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp cumin, 3 crushed garlic cloves and salt. Put in a tin with 250ml water, cover tightly with foil and roast 4 hours until it pulls apart. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff. Blitz parsley, coriander and mint with lemon juice and 4 tbsp oil and stir through until green. Top with pomegranate seeds and mint yoghurt.
W: the shoes Elphaba enchants for her sister

Sweet pastry tarts filled with cold vanilla custard and topped with raspberries glazed bright ruby red. Bake 8 small tart cases cut from 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C for 12 minutes. Make custard from 3 tbsp custard powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 500ml milk, cool and fill the cases. Top with 250g raspberries brushed with warm raspberry jam.
K: Glinda floating in on her bubble

Fresh mint and lime muddled with sugar, topped with soda water over ice. Muddle a handful of mint leaves with the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp sugar in a jug. Add ice and top with 1L soda water, stir and pour into 4 glasses with a mint sprig each.

s.note: the Emerald City, green from top to bottom
s.how: Blitz 100g pistachios fine. Beat 150g butter with 60g icing sugar, then mix in 180g flour and the pistachios. Roll into a log, chill 30 minutes, slice into 20 rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

Line a 12-hole tray with rounds cut from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml cream, 80g grated gruyère and snipped chives, pour into the cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.

m.how: Push 60g butter mixed with chopped tarragon and lemon zest under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 800g potatoes in chunks around it. Steam 300g green beans and toss in the pan juices.
